name: Workamajig
description: Workamajig is an integrated agency-management platform for project planning, resource scheduling, CRM, time and expense tracking, billing, accounting and reporting. Agencies use it to coordinate client work and operational and financial data in one system.
agentUseSummary: Workamajig documents a token-authenticated REST API, but the exact resource paths, request and response schemas, pagination and errors are available only inside an authenticated customer account. Its one fully public endpoint is a customer-defined Reports feed that may return arbitrary columns and up to 10,000 rows. Relay therefore exposes no Workamajig actions until the private contract is safely reviewed and converted to bounded typed tools.

blocked.label: Connect Workamajig tokens
blocked.description: Relay will not request a company APIAccessToken or per-user UserToken until the exact customer API contract and credential lifecycle have been reviewed.

blocked.label: Use account-gated REST resources
blocked.description: Public documentation names API modules but leaves their exact paths, parameters, schemas, pagination and error contracts inside the authenticated Workamajig interface.

blocked.label: Run Workamajig reports
blocked.description: The public Reports API accepts customer-defined reports with arbitrary columns and filters and can return up to 10,000 records, so it is not a fixed bounded metadata tool.

blocked.label: Expose sensitive agency data
blocked.description: Contacts, companies, projects, time, expenses, invoices, accounting, CRM, diary and other operational or financial data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Mutate Workamajig records
blocked.description: Creates, updates, deletes, bulk changes and other writes are blocked because their exact contracts, permission effects and collision behavior are not publicly reviewable.

blocked.label: Automate private Workamajig interfaces
blocked.description: Relay will not log in to customer-only documentation, scrape the application, replay browser traffic, reuse sessions or reverse engineer private endpoints.

blocked.label: Expose raw or bulk Workamajig access
blocked.description: Relay will not proxy arbitrary API paths, arbitrary custom reports, unbounded responses or raw exports to agents.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Workamajig agent action can be enabled until the account-gated API contract is reviewed and implemented as version-pinned, bounded typed tools.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw cannot install guessed Workamajig resource calls or an arbitrary high-volume Reports feed; a reviewed typed Railway wrapper is required.
Hermes cannot install guessed Workamajig resource calls or an arbitrary high-volume Reports feed; a reviewed typed Railway wrapper is required.

providerSetup.blocker: Workamajig publicly documents a beta1 REST API at each customer's subdomain and a two-token authorization model, but places the complete module documentation and sample code behind the authenticated Admin/Manager interface. The public overview names activities, companies, contacts, opportunities, projects, tasks, todos, vendor invoices and other modules without publishing their complete typed contracts. The separate public Reports API is explicitly customer-defined and may return up to 10,000 rows, which is too broad to substitute for reviewed fixed tools.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request Workamajig tokens and do not show Connect. In the separate provider-console acceptance task, use a disposable tenant containing synthetic data and a dedicated least-authority user, review and export the current beta1 documentation without secrets, and record exact paths, methods, schemas, pagination, rate limits, error behavior, user-right enforcement, rotation and revocation. Then implement only fixed bounded metadata reads and separately reviewed minimal mutations; do not expose arbitrary reports or raw API access.

evidence.supports: Workamajig documents its beta1 REST API, customer-subdomain URL pattern, module-level rate limits, APIAccessToken plus UserToken authorization, user-right enforcement and the account-only location of complete API documentation and sample code.
Workamajig documents the public Reports endpoint, customer-defined report columns and filters, a maximum of 10,000 records and a limit of five active reports per fifteen minutes.
Workamajig describes APIs that can transmit data in both directions and identifies the read-only Reports API as a common integration, establishing that write-capable modules require explicit review.
Workamajig's official API information section indexes the public overview and Reports guidance but does not expose the complete customer-only resource reference.
